purpose: Prove release-before-cancel compensation for an inventory-reserved Order created from an exact published Listing offer.
environment_policy: local, demo, or disposable test tenant only
credentials: environment variables only; never command arguments, scenario files, or ledgers
flow: create and publish one governed Listing offer
place Order from the exact published Listing offer
reserve 2 units and bind the exact reservation to the Order item
release the reservation with the same TRADE_ORDER business identity
cancel only after Order validates that every reservation is RELEASED
prove the terminal Order has no payment, fulfillment, or shipment reference
immediately replay all 12 commands and require immutable duplicate results
invariants: PLACE_FROM_LISTING includes explicit listing_id and listing_offer_id
RELEASE uses the same reservation, business type, Order ID, and Order item ID as RESERVE
CANCEL executes only after canonical Inventory proves the reservation is RELEASED
terminal Inventory is exactly on_hand=10, reserved=0, available=10
the executed-domain ledger contains no payment or fulfillment command
terminal Order payment_id, fulfillment_id, and shipment_id are all null
the runner emits run-scoped absence expectations as a lakehouse integration hook without assuming an external command name
cleanup: the release and cancellation are the compensation; retain immutable ledger, histories, and Outbox evidence
